block.neroarcade.arcade_cabinet.tooltip: Insert a cartridge, then use it with an empty hand to play. Sneak-use to take the cartridge out.
block.neroarcade.arcade_exchange.tooltip: Will let players share their games with the whole server and download others'.
block.neroarcade.cartridge_duplicator.to: Will copy a cartridge onto a Blank Cartridge, keeping its credit.
block.neroarcade.game_bench.tooltip: Build a game from module chips, test it, and save it to a Blank Cartridge.
block.neroarcade.link_bus.tooltip: Will join up to four cabinets so players can play together.
block.neroarcade.link_cable.tooltip: Will carry a game from a Link Bus to the cabinets it joins.
block.neroarcade.marquee_screen.tooltip: Will show the game on a linked cabinet and its best scores. Sneak-use to change its size.
gui.neroarcade.menu_open_failed: This screen could not be opened on this server. The server log has the details.
item.neroarcade.blank_cartridge.tooltip: Put it in a Game Bench tray and save a game onto it.
item.neroarcade.blank_chip.tooltip: Craft it with a part to make a module chip.
item.neroarcade.module_chip.stacks: Up to three of this slot stack in one game.
item.neroarcade.module_chip.unknown: A chip this server does not know.
module.neroarcade.arena.grid_16.desc: A 16 by 16 board with a wall border and optional obstacles.
module.neroarcade.control.four_way.desc: Up, down, left and right to move, plus the A and B buttons.
module.neroarcade.multiplayer.solo.desc: One player has the whole board.
module.neroarcade.pace.steady.desc: The game runs at one constant speed. Slow-down 1 is full speed; 4 is a quarter of it.
module.neroarcade.pawn.cursor.desc: A free cursor that moves in four directions and stops at walls.
module.neroarcade.rule.survive_time.desc: Stay alive until the timer runs out; with no hazard it is won by waiting.
module.neroarcade.theme.neon_void.desc: Bright neon shapes on a dark field, in four variants.
neroarcade.bench.ghost: From the loaded cartridge — clear it to place your own chip.
neroarcade.bench.ghost_tip: Loaded from cartridge — CLEAR (✕ on this row) to remove.
neroarcade.bench.help.clear: Remove the chips that came from the loaded cartridge, so you can put in your own.
neroarcade.bench.help.load: Put the tray cartridge's chips in the rack so you can change them.
neroarcade.bench.help.prop.bool: %s: click to turn it on or off.
neroarcade.bench.help.prop.enum: %s: click for the next choice, right-click for the previous one.
neroarcade.bench.help.prop.int: %s: click or drag to set it; the mouse wheel steps by one.
neroarcade.bench.help.row: Click the row to edit this chip's settings on the right.
neroarcade.bench.help.save: Write this game onto the cartridge in the tray.
neroarcade.bench.help.test_play: Play this game right here with the arcade keys (%s %s %s %s, %s). ESC stops it and closes the bench.
neroarcade.bench.help.title: Your game's name, 1 to %s characters. It shows on the cabinet.
neroarcade.bench.load_disabled: Put a cartridge in the tray
neroarcade.bench.params_empty: %s is empty. Put a chip in the slot to add one.
neroarcade.bench.params_empty_default: %s is empty, so the game uses %s. Put a chip in the slot to change its settings.
neroarcade.bench.preview_caption: Live demo — restarts on every change
neroarcade.bench.save_disabled: Put a Blank Cartridge in the tray
neroarcade.bench.status.busy: ARCADE BUSY — too many games are running. Try again soon.
neroarcade.bench.status.failed: That did not work. The server log has the details.
neroarcade.bench.status.hint: Hover any slot or button to see what it does.
neroarcade.bench.status.loaded: Loaded. The rack now shows that game.
neroarcade.bench.status.need_blank: Put a Blank Cartridge in the tray.
neroarcade.bench.status.need_cartridge: Put a cartridge in the tray to load it.
neroarcade.bench.status.need_title: Give your game a title first.
neroarcade.bench.status.not_yours: That cartridge is another builder's. Put a Blank Cartridge in the tray to save your remix.
neroarcade.bench.status.other_cartridge: That is a different game. Put a Blank Cartridge in the tray, or LOAD this one first.
neroarcade.bench.status.seated_elsewhere: You are seated at a cabinet. Leave that seat first.
neroarcade.bench.status.test_started: Test play started. Press ESC to stop.
neroarcade.bench.status.testing: A test play is running. Stop it first.
neroarcade.bench.subtitle: Drop chips in the rack. Empty slots use the default shown in grey.
neroarcade.bench.testing_over: Test over — %s plays again, ESC closes the bench
neroarcade.bench.tray_hint: Blank Cartridge to save, or a cartridge to load.
neroarcade.bench.warning.aim_without_fir: This control aims, but the pawn cannot fire. Aim is ignored.
neroarcade.bench.warning.clear_board_wit: There is nothing to clear, so this plays as a survival game.
neroarcade.bench.warning.crowded: Three hazards on a small board with a moving pawn: expect short games.
neroarcade.bench.warning.exit_on_one_axi: The pawn moves on one line, so the exit is placed at the far end of that line.
neroarcade.bench.warning.key_without_exi: Nothing uses the key, so it counts as an orb worth 5 points.
neroarcade.bench.warning.no_threat: Nothing can hurt the pawn, so this is won by waiting.
neroarcade.bench.warning.one_button_free: With one button the pawn moves on its own: A reverses, B stops.
neroarcade.bench.warning.score_rule_with: This rule needs points, but no pickup gives any. The match can only end by lives or time.
neroarcade.bench.warning.two_way_on_free: This control moves on one axis, so the pawn will too.
neroarcade.bench.warning.unknown_propert: Some settings are not used by this server and will be removed when you save.
neroarcade.bench.warning.versus_needs_se: Needs 2 seats. Link another cabinet, or it plays solo.
neroarcade.bench.why.cannot_run: This game cannot run yet — the status bar says why.
neroarcade.bench.why.invalid: This game cannot be saved until the problem in the status bar is fixed.
neroarcade.bench.why.need_blank: Put a Blank Cartridge in the tray to save.
neroarcade.bench.why.need_cartridge: Put a saved cartridge in the tray to load it.
neroarcade.bench.why.need_title: Type a title for your game first.
neroarcade.bench.why.waiting: Waiting for the bench to answer.
neroarcade.cabinet.msg.already_seated: You are already seated at %s %s %s. Leave that seat first.
neroarcade.cabinet.msg.blank: This cartridge is blank. Save a game onto it at a Game Bench first.
neroarcade.cabinet.msg.eject_in_progress: A match is running. Leave your seat before taking the cartridge out.
neroarcade.cabinet.msg.in_progress: Match in progress. Wait for it to end.
neroarcade.cabinet.msg.inserted: Cartridge in. Use the cabinet with an empty hand to play.
neroarcade.cabinet.msg.no_cartridge: NO CARTRIDGE — insert one to play.
neroarcade.cabinet.msg.no_power: NO POWER — this cabinet needs power to play.
neroarcade.cabinet.msg.occupied: This cabinet already has a cartridge. Sneak-use to take it out.
neroarcade.cabinet.msg.taken: Taken — someone is already playing here.
neroarcade.cabinet.msg.your_turn: An arcade cabinet is free now. Use it again to play.
neroarcade.cartridge.error.bad_id: This cartridge has an invalid id.
neroarcade.cartridge.error.bad_title: The title must be 1–32 plain characters.
neroarcade.cartridge.error.newer_schema: This cartridge was made on a newer version of NeroArcade.
neroarcade.cartridge.error.over_budget: This game exceeds this server's limits (%s).
neroarcade.cartridge.error.too_large: This cartridge is too large to read (%s KB, limit %s KB).
neroarcade.cartridge.error.unknown_modul: This cartridge uses a module this server does not have: %s.
neroarcade.command.inspect.not_cartridge: Hold a cartridge in your main hand.
neroarcade.hud.seated: Seated — the game has your controls
neroarcade.seat.dropped.broken: The cabinet was broken or its cartridge taken out.
neroarcade.seat.dropped.host_gone: The cabinet running this game is gone.
neroarcade.seat.dropped.power: The cabinet ran out of power.
neroarcade.seat.dropped.range: You walked away from the cabinet, so your seat was released.
slot.neroarcade.arena.desc: The board: its size, its walls and whether its edges wrap.
slot.neroarcade.control.desc: How the buttons turn into movement and actions.
slot.neroarcade.hazard.desc: What threatens the pawns; up to three hazards stack.
slot.neroarcade.modifier.desc: One twist on the whole game, such as wrapping edges or fog.
slot.neroarcade.multiplayer.desc: How many players take part and whether they team up or compete.
slot.neroarcade.pace.desc: How fast the game runs and whether it speeds up.
slot.neroarcade.pawn.desc: What each player controls and how it moves.
slot.neroarcade.pickup.desc: What the pawns collect; up to three pickups stack.
slot.neroarcade.rule.desc: How a match is won or lost.
slot.neroarcade.theme.desc: The colours, sprites and sounds of the screen.
